admission.justification: Spans every settings reader: D109's one-time whole-file move plus the shared location guard with old-only/both-path refusal is the mechanism FAM-6M4B49's single-location guarantee is built on.

applicability: Every reader of user settings on the current line.
conditions: The single standard user config location guard resolves the path.
Old-only and both-path states refuse without a compatibility reader.
exclusions: A compatibility reader for the old path.
statement: D109 moves the whole user settings file once to the standard user config location; every current-line old-path reader uses the same location guard, and old-only/both-path states refuse without a compatibility reader.
